description.narrative: The ICSP Development Stream in Sierra Leone, implemented by partners Green Scenery, BAN, NMJD, Wones and SEND promotes more inclusive, transparent, gender responsive and accountable institutions in Sierra Leone. The ICSP Development Stream in Sierra Leone, implemented by partners Green Scenery, BAN, NMJD, Wones and SEND promotes more inclusive, transparent, gender responsive and accountable institutions in Sierra Leone. The programme is implemented in Kono, Falaba, Pujehun, Bombali, Port Loko, Western Area rural, Kailahun. To support political inclusion and participation, particularly of women; transparent land governance, partns work with cattle rearers and crop farming communities in Community Action Groups to enable conflict resolution and peaceful coexistence; advocate for more transparent, accountable and responsive land policies and defence of land rights, and undertake district Multi-stakeholder Platforms to support Rights Holders to engage and hold duty bearers accountable on issues and concerns related to land and cattle settlement. Communities prone to climate induced disaster and environmental risks are supported to develop their resilience to climate change and protect their local environment, particuarly with forestry actions. Partners promote womens political empowerment with Women in Governance Networks for increased women's participation and representation in political governance and decision making at all levels to achieve government gender quota (30%). At national level and regional level, partners research and advocate for transparent public financial management and accountability and network with civil society to enable broad based efforts to lobby for transparency and budget responsiveness. In In 2025 the programme reached approximately 4000 people directly and a further 22,230 indirectly. .
